message.content: The drive from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 380–400 miles (about 610–640 km) along the I‑5 corridor. Under normal conditions—no major traffic, no detours, and staying within speed limits—the trip typically takes around **6 to 7 hours**. If you’re traveling during rush hour or on weekends, you might add an extra hour or two for congestion, especially near the Bay Area and the Los Angeles metro area.
